en: I am about to start a new project.
The meeting is about to begin.
I was about to send you a message.
I finally got around to cleaning my room.
He got around to studying for the exam.
They got around to preparing the presentation.

tr: Senin yardımın sayesinde projeyi zamanında bitirdim.
en: Thanks to your help, I finished the project on time.
You should stick to your plan.
He always sticks to his principles.
